title: ARMv8-A Next-Generation Vector Architecture for HPC
version: Arm's Hot Chips 28 presentation deck, v12, dated 22 August 2016

passages.note: Dates the Cupertino presentation and describes SVE as an extension of AArch64. The design allows different vector lengths and uses predication with a common encoding.
Illustrates vector-length-agnostic software and identifies HPC partners as an audience for SVE.
